bill.title: A Resolution recognizing November 20, 2026, as "Transgender Day of Remembrance" in Pennsylvania.

posted_text:
🏳️‍⚧️ LGBTQ
PA HR 674 — Pennsylvania Acknowledges Transgender Day of Remembrance

The House of Representatives will recognize November 20, 2026, as ‘Transgender Day of Remembrance’ in Pennsylvania. The resolution cites ongoing violence against transgender people, noting that they are over four times more likely to experience violent crime than cisgender individuals and that at least 32 transgender people were killed through violence in 2024, including some in Pennsylvania. ...
